label: 1D Groovy recursion
title: When does a one-dimensional G field have an autonomous G field?
summary: Among 36 present-only first-level laws, 33 have constant native G. Rules 2 and 16 have nonconstant second-generation closure on inherited fields under two specified derived rules; Rule 32 fails for both radius-one choices.
takeaway: A second generation can close in 1D, but the inherited domain matters: the three tested nonpointwise descendant rules fail present-only G closure when started from arbitrary binary rows.

label: Third 1D Groovy generation
title: A third recursive G exists for two explicit 1D chains
summary: Rules 2 and 16 extend to a nonconstant third G with a radius-four inherited update on the first-one / second-zero branch. Other fixed choices fail or remain unresolved beyond radius four.
takeaway: Third-generation closure exists in 1D under explicit rules; the choices for unused entries change the closure verdict, and no fourth generation has been tested.
